description: Provides financial compensation to farmers during severe crop loss caused by natural calamities, wildlife damage, or unseasonal weather.
benefits: Financial assistance ranging from ₹20,000 to ₹1,00,000 per hectare depending on the crop and extent of damage.
eligibility: Farmers residing in Goa with registered agriculture land or Krishi Card
Cultivators of paddy, sugarcane, cashew, coconut, spices, and vegetables
documents: Land Ownership Document (Form I & XIV) / Lease Deed

scheme_name: Assistance for Fencing / Crop Protection Scheme
description: Offers subsidy for constructing perimeter fencing (solar, chain-link, or bio-fencing) to protect crops from wild animals like wild boars and stray cattle.
benefits: 75% to 90% subsidy on total cost of chain-link, stone masonry, or solar fencing installation.
eligibility: Individual farmers, farmer groups, or tenant farmers holding Krishi Card in Goa
documents: Form I & XIV / Land Record Copy
Estimate and Invoice from Approved Vendor

description: Encourages cashew cultivation by offering subsidies for fresh cashew planting, high-yielding graft varieties, and rejuvenating old unproductive cashew orchards.
benefits: Subsidy up to ₹40,000 per hectare for planting high-yielding cashew grafts and maintaining orchards.
eligibility: Goan farmers owning land suitable for cashew cultivation holding a Krishi Card

description: Promotes eco-friendly agricultural practices by subsidizing the construction of organic manure units, vermicompost units, and organic certification.
benefits: 50% subsidy up to ₹50,000 for constructing permanent vermicompost units and purchasing organic inputs.
eligibility: Registered Goan farmers practicing or adopting organic farming methods

description: Provides capital subsidies to purchase tractors, power tillers, brush cutters, weeders, and paddy transplanters to address labor shortage.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on cost of agricultural machinery (up to ₹2,50,000 per machine depending on category).
eligibility: Krishi Card holding farmers and Registered Farmers' Clubs/Self Help Groups in Goa

scheme_name: Goa Paddy Cultivation Incentive Scheme (Assured Price Support)
description: Provides an assured minimum support price/incentive for paddy produced and sold by local farmers to government-designated procurement agencies.
benefits: Direct incentive bonus over MSP (up to ₹20–₹25 per kg) credited straight to the farmer's bank account.
eligibility: Paddy growers in Goa holding a valid Krishi Card and registered with ZAO
documents: Paddy Procurement Receipt / Crop Sowing Certificate from ZAO
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agricultural Office / Procurement Centers

description: Supports livestock farmers in purchasing crossbred cows and high-yielding buffaloes to make Goa self-sufficient in milk production.
benefits: Subsidy ranging from 80% to 90% of the cost of crossbred cows/buffaloes (up to 10 animals per beneficiary), including transport and insurance.
eligibility: Residents of Goa for at least 5 years engaged in or starting dairy farming
application_mode: Offline via Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services (AHVS)

description: Assists groups of farmers in constructing community borewells, open wells, and installing micro-irrigation systems in water-scarce zones.
benefits: 75% to 90% financial grant for drilling borewells, pump set setup, and drip/sprinkler pipeline installation.
eligibility: Group of at least 3 to 5 farmers owning adjoining cultivable lands in Goa holding Krishi Cards
documents: Krishi Cards of All Group Members
Form I & XIV of Adjoining Plots

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Brackish Water / Freshwater Aquaculture
description: Encourages fish, crab, and shrimp farming in brackish water estuaries and freshwater ponds across coastal and inland areas.
benefits: 40% to 60% capital subsidy for pond construction, seed purchase, feed, and aeration equipment.
eligibility: Inland fishers, youth entrepreneurs, and SHGs in Goa holding suitable waterbodies or land
documents: Land Record / Lease Deed of Water Body
application_mode: Offline via Directorate of Fisheries, Panaji

scheme_name: Cultivation of High Value / Protected Crops in Polyhouse
description: Promotes modern protected cultivation of orchids, anthuriums, exotic vegetables, and capsicum using polyhouses and shade-net structures.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on polyhouse/shade-net structure construction costs and quality planting material.
eligibility: Individual progressive farmers or farmer producer organizations (FPOs) in Goa with valid Krishi Card
application_mode: Offline via State Horticulture Corporation / ZAO
